_note: One word sort for each lesson: the columns it sorts into, the words that go in each, and the odd ones out that go in none. 95% Group's weekly timing guide gives word sorting seventeen minutes a week, the largest block in the lesson, and it is the one component that asks whether a word HAS the pattern rather than asking a child to read a word that does. Words come from scripts/reading-spelling.json, so they are the same hand-authored, sequence-checked words the dictation uses. The odd ones out are words already taught that match no column, so the sort cannot be finished by elimination. Generated by scripts/build-word-sort.mjs; do not hand-edit.
